name: kitsu
description: Verify a coding task with one command in Codex or Claude Code, resume saved tasks, and keep verification evidence with the worktree.

interface.shortDescription: Verify coding tasks and gate commits
interface.longDescription: Start or resume a task in either coding host. One command opens the task, runs its assertion and commits the verified change. Kitsu saves the task's scope, checks and review evidence in the worktree. An optional Git gate checks evidence before commits and pushes. Role coordination and supervised runs are in the opt-in kitsu-team plugin.
defaultPrompt: Use the task skill to implement a change and verify it before the commit
Set up the checks and the Git gate for this repository
